_comment: Composed wave 5 — application-service/apigateway + compute/scf closure 2026-06-13. gen-wave5-apigw-policy rides the VALIDATED apigw-api chain (gen-wave-apigw 20/20 green) and adds the id-bound GET leftovers + deleteresourcepolicy. gen-wave5-apigw-privatelink is the self-contained privatelink chain: own vpc/subnet (10.163.0.0/20 — unused block) -> networking privatelink-service (AUTO approval, IP type, UNPROVEN docs DTO) -> apigw privatelink-endpoint family AND the scf privatelink-endpoint family against the SAME provider service (one infra chain, all UNPROVEN privatelink risk isolated here; split into a 4th id if the owner prefers). gen-wave5-scf-triggers: apigateway trigger against our own apigw api/stage (verbatim ApigatewayTriggerCreateRequest), listtriggers with the required cloud_function_id query, codes/file + logs/metrics probes. DTOs verbatim from data/api_docs.json; quirks honoured: trigger DELETE needs json {cloud_function_id, trigger_type in [cron, apigateway]} (run 27417986669), scf privatelink-SERVICE enable strands the function in Creating (only disable=false probed), every scf config write flips Deploying -> READY re-poll before the next write/delete. NOTE (2026-06-15 hygiene fix): the three wait-*-gone delete-poll steps (wait-api-gone in apigw-policy, wait-function-gone in apigw-privatelink + scf-triggers) had scalar until_status: 404 — corrected to the list form [404] (engine already coerces, this is correctness hygiene per S's triage). The until_status: 404 originates only here (composer-generated delete-gone poll); the apigateway/scf model nodes carry no until_status field. A future re-compose of this file must EMIT until_status as a LIST ([404]) so the scalar does not reappear.

lifecycles._note: Closes the apigw GET leftovers (showresource/listmethods/showmethod/showstage/listreports/showauth/showaccesscontrol/showusageplan/listapikeys) + deleteresourcepolicy on our own api. Every create body is the VALIDATED gen-wave-apigw shape; the resource-policy document is the proven setresourcepolicy shape from apigateway-api-write-coverage, srn pointed at THIS api. listreports allows 400 — docs model has no params but the apigw-api node note suspects a required period query (R3).

ADOPT-class 고정 IP 재호밍 규칙(knowledge/domain-constraints.md)대로 10.124.0.7/.8로 정정 — fixed_ip_map 선점분(.5/.6 vpc-privatelink-service, .20 vpc-endpoint, .30/.31 lb-members-nat, .100~.102 lb 기본값)과 비충돌(전 시나리오 grep 확인 2026-07-08; dependencies.json fixed_ip_map에 .7/.8 등재는 후속). 듀얼모드 주의(validated-facts.md): 공유 인프라 없는 단독(자가 생성 10.163.8.0/24) 실행에선 이 IP가 역으로 대역 밖 400 → optional+group이라 privatelink-service 그룹 스킵으로 관용되고, xdist 전런에선 IB-049가 자가 생성을 막아 adopt 모드가 유일 경로.
